name: AR_SUM_PENDING_CMAPP
description: AR_SUM_PENDING_CMAPP is used in the Receivables Dashboard and displays the summary information for credit memos pending application.

columns.name: PENDING_CMAPP_SUM_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of Primary Key associated to the row

columns.name: CM_COUNT
columns.description: Indicates count of credit memos pending application associated to the row

columns.name: CM_AMT
columns.description: Indicates accounted amount of credit memos pending application associated to the row

columns.name: TRX_DATE
columns.description: Indicates credit memo transaction date  associated to the row

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Indicates General Ledger Period Name associated to the row

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Indicates Currency Code associated to the row
